# orion ingest

Import work from configured sources and refresh the cards they track

```sh
orion ingest [options]
```

| Argument           | Description                  |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------- |
| `--dry-run`        | Show changes without writing |
| `--source <value>` | Only ingest this source id   |
| `--json`           | Print JSON                   |
